names.note: The Greek form saint.gr prints in the body of the life, «Ο Άγιος Ουϊστάνος (Wistan)»; the calendar's own line for 1 Ιουνίου has «Άγιος Ουϊστάν ο βασιλεύς», with the rank word left off here. The page gives the Latin spelling in brackets and the display name follows it.

death.note: saint.gr: «τον δολοφόνησαν, το 849 μ.Χ., κατά τη στιγμή που εκείνος πλησίαζε τον ξάδελφό του, για να τον χαιρετήσει.» The page's heading is «Άγιος Ουϊστάν (; - 849)» and gives no year of birth; it dates the regent Berhtwulf's rule 840 to 852.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ουϊστάν ο βασιλεύς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page calls him king and never martyr, although it says he was murdered, so `types` carries `king` alone and no reading of passion-bearer is put into the folder — the same course the 29 Μαΐου Ethelbert took. It names Mercia as his grandfather's kingdom and no kingdom of his own, so no `locations` are entered. The corpus keeps no other Wistan. No hymn is printed for him.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
